summary: A document corpus: runbooks, specs, notes, PDFs.
prompt_delta: The material is a DOCUMENT CORPUS (runbooks, specs, notes, PDFs).
Extraction first: pull out each concrete fact, rule, figure and procedure, and cite the document (and section or page) it came from.

Compare the documents in this unit against each other. Where two disagree -- a different value, a different procedure, an older version of the same rule -- record it in `contradictions` naming both sources. Do not resolve it by picking one; the owner decides.
Note which documents look superseded or stale, and why.

documents.description: Objects {path, title, kind, stale} for every document read.

contradictions.description: Objects {a, b, detail}: two citations in this unit that disagree, and how.
